The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.
samples.ref: Twipin wichuptan, akichisoh tai, Twikhanglenin eichupsoh hel ahitai, Twipi kidil’in eilonvuh tai.
samples.hyp: Twikhanglenin eiumkimvel’in, Twipi kongin eiumkimvel’e! Kavun’uva twi chun eisuhmang jengui!

samples.src:
Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
samples.ref: Kon khatsen vang kabulput henlhah na hi genthei kathoh be cheh ding dei naa lung theng louva Christa asei phongu ahibouve.
samples.hyp: Hiche hi khatvei thilpha Kipana Thupha huhdohna dinga eikigonsah ahi ti kahe jeh a ngailutna'a kasei ahibouve.
